title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori

thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 9 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode entertaining, especially its humor, romantic tension, and clever character interactions.
The episode’s strategic and suspenseful elements were viewed favorably, with commenters appreciating the protagonists’ plans and the escalating complications.
Some reactions treated the romantic material as amusing and effective, while also seeing it as exaggerated or uncomfortable for the characters.
A few comments expressed frustration with the repeated mind-control-related developments and with characters’ decisions producing little practical benefit.
